---
  title: Video Examples
  ---
  
  This section contains curated videos to support and extend what you are learning each week. They cover key concepts in statistics, R programming, and data visualisation — selected to complement the [r4np readings](https://r4np.com){target="_blank"} and the interactive lesson materials.
  
  Visit this section alongside the lesson for each week. The videos are a great way to see concepts explained from a different angle, and to get a sense of how working data scientists and statisticians think about the problems you are tackling.
  
  You should watch the videos before writing your weekly reflctions, but you do not need to watch every minute of every video. Simply focus on what is most relevant to what you are finding challenging or interesting that week.
